experiments.procedure_text: Immunohistochemistry and FISH were conducted on CeA tissue sections to characterize CART-positive neurons in alcohol naïve iP rats and Cre-reporter mice.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: To characterise the neurochemical phenotype of CART-positive CeA neurons, immunohistochemistry was conducted for CART/PKCδ in alcohol naïve adult male iP rats (n = 3) and CART/tdTomato (tdT) in pENK-IRES-Cre::Ai14 (n = 3) and CRF-IRES-Cre::Ai14 mice (n = 3). Fluroescent in situ hybirdisation (FISH; RNAScope) was conducted for Cartpt/Nts and Cartpt/Drd2 in alcohol naïve adult male iP rats (n = 3)
experiments.animal_counts_evidence: alcohol naïve adult male iP rats (n = 3)
experiments.test_system_evidence: immunohistochemistry was conducted... Fluroescent in situ hybirdisation (FISH; RNAScope) was conducted
experiments.regulatory_evidence: performed in accordance with the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act (2004), under the guidelines of the National Health and Medical Research Council Code of Practice for the Care and Use of Animals for Experimental Purposes in Australia (2013) and approved by The Florey Animal Ethics Committee
experiments.notes: Includes phenotyping of mouse cohorts (pENK-IRES-Cre::Ai14 and CRF-IRES-Cre::Ai14, 3 per genotype).

experiments.study_type: Yohimbine-induced reinstatement of alcohol seeking effect on Fos-positive CART cell expression
experiments.procedure_text: Rats underwent alcohol self-administration training, reinstatement testing, and transcardial perfusion for immunohistochemical analysis of CART/Fos co-localisation in the CeA.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: Rats underwent transcardial perfusion 60 min after the end of the reinstatement test (or equivalent), followed by immunohistochemistry to examine CART and Fos co-localisation within the CeA.

endpoints.label: Fos/CART co-localisation
endpoints.evidence: immunohistochemistry to examine CART and Fos co-localisation within the CeA

experiments.exposure_evidence: 30 min following administration of yohimbine (1 mg/kg, i.p.)
